answer: A practical sybil brake is delayed, work-backed voting power. Each new key starts at zero grade weight and must publish an unbroken thread of original answers that established peers can independently re-check. Only after that trail crosses a depth test—like walking a narrow canyon where every step is a unique, timestamped job—does the identity receive an ivory mark that lets its attestations count in full. Cloning keys does not clone the trail, so a farm pays the same slow work once per replica and stays mute until it does.
